message: 虚空の疲れ目

name: Nanaka
message: 「Found 'Servant of the Frenzied God'! How about over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got 'Three Stigmata Carved by the Cursed Barber'!」

name: Melilot
message: 「'Rotting Undead,' 'Roadside Slaughter,' and 'Greet the Morning of Pig-Slaying' are right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much for going out of your way.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Accommodating our patrons is part of a librarian's duty, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that all of 'em?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... 'Sacred Massacre,' 'Bludgeoning Humanity to Death,' 'Worship the Morning of Slaughter,' 'High Supper of the Black Daifuku Cult'...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's all of 'em.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, every single one of these covers is, like, creepy, or gross, or just... y'know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Cause it's death meta.」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Death metal... probably.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you checking out, Azel?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's see, 'The Everyday Right There'?」
Azel hid the photo book, whose cover featured a nostalgic back-alley scene, behind his back, and then.

name: Azel
message: 「I am the one asking the question here.」

name: Synn
message: 「They're music CDs.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Your hobby?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. For a guest.」

name: Azel
message: 「A guest?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The musician staying at Synn's place.」
With Azel clutching his photo book as if it were precious and us having stuffed the CDs into the paper bag Melilot gave us, we headed outside.

name: Synn
message: 「Ringer said he wanted to listen to human death metal, see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, you actually asked what he wanted and went out of your way to borrow it? Jeez, Synn, you're way too soft-hearted」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, he doesn't have any money to buy things, and Demons don't have library cards」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fair enough」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you let me use your library card too, Nanaka」
At the library, each person is only allowed to borrow a maximum of five items.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess it's what they call a fated brush of sleeves, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「...Why go this far for me」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm only doing what I can」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep」

name: Azel
message: 「We are not of the same kind」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no difference」

name: Azel
message: 「No difference?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. At least to me, I don't think they're any different from us aside from appearances」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Roro and Sally are no different from us either, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, don't mention to Lolotte that she's an angel, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's super obvious, though she seems to think she's hiding it」

name: Azel
message: 「...Understood」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait a sec, do you even have a way to play that at your place, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Knew it. My old man used to have one, so I'll lend it to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, Azel, did you get your furniture and stuff sorted out?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」
Azel was no longer standing beside them.
When we hurriedly looked back, Azel had stopped in his tracks and was staring at something.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is something wrong with Finis Tower?」
I looked in the direction Azel was gazing.
It wasn't the tower. He was looking at an empty patch of sky just above it.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you want to take a picture?」
Azel briskly started walking away.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you... see something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「An unidentified flying object!?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw, man」

name: Azel
message: 「...If you can't see anything, that's fine」
